title: news.article.published
description: Producer: news-ingestor (ArticlePublishedEvent.java, backlog #79). publishedAt's real wire encoding was never independently re-verified against a live producer (sentiment-analyzer/app/events.py's own docstring states this honestly, backlog #96) -- accepting both a JSON number (an Instant encoded as epoch time) and a string (an ISO-8601 encoding) is the schema's own honest reflection of that unresolved ambiguity, not an assumption either way.
